name: Project names and clones
summary: How project names must be unique, and how a project shared between companies becomes independent clones.

roles.note: No clone-specific permission string exists. Who may start a cross-company clone is unknown.

actions.action: Clone a project to another company

nfr.statement: Time for a cross-company clone to finish and become usable.
nfr.open_question: How long may cloning take for a large project, and how is progress shown?

requirements.title: Project names are unique within a company only
requirements.statement: Two projects in the same company may not share a name. Projects in different companies may, including the independent clones of a shared project. Case, spacing, renames and archived or deleted projects are open (DEC-020).

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

acceptance_criteria.given: Company A already has a project named Tower A
acceptance_criteria.when: Someone in A creates another project named Tower A
acceptance_criteria.then: It is rejected as a duplicate

acceptance_criteria.given: Company A has a project named Tower A
acceptance_criteria.when: Company B creates a project named Tower A

requirements.title: Project names are unique across all companies today
requirements.statement: The projects collection has a unique index on name alone. Today no two projects in any company can share a name, so company B can't create a Tower A once company A has one.

dispute.summary: PROJ-REQ-019 allows the same name in different companies. The shared models declare name as globally unique, and the index registry records that index from live $indexStats as matching constructn-api. Engineering to plan a company-scoped index (with a data check) once DEC-020 fixes the normalisation rules.

requirements.title: Shared projects become independent clones per company
requirements.statement: If two companies share a project, each gets its own clone. After creation, changes to one clone never affect the other. What a clone copies is open (DEC-021).

requirements.title: Cloning runs in an external worker
requirements.statement: Cloning checks the source project, then asks an external duplication service to do the copy. When it calls back, the new project's status is set to the original's.
